title: Cutting a transition table into read blocks
statement: Let $k,n\in\mathbb{N}$, and let a transition table assign an action to each state in $\{0,\ldots,n\}$, each input read in $\{\text{blank},0,1\}$, and each tuple of $k$ work-tape reads in $\{\text{blank},0,1\}^k$. For any state $q$, input read $a$, and work-tape read tuple $w$, the bit string encoding the full table can be decomposed into the encodings of $q$ complete earlier state blocks, then $r$ read entries within state $q$, then the encoding of the action at $(q,a,w)$, followed by a tail. Here there are $q$ earlier blocks, each containing $3^{k+1}$ actions, and $r$ is the rank of $(a,w)$ in the ordering that first orders input reads and then work-tape read tuples.
hypotheses_covered: A transition table on states, input reads, and work-tape read tuples
